say:1:1041547901:1.text: Wow, this place is great! It'd be even better with some music!
say:1:1041547901:1.source_cn: 这儿真是个好地方，要是再来点音乐就更好了。

say:2:1041547902:1.text: Oh, Lyca, perfect! Want to hear all the fun stuff I ran into on my travels? With some music, of course!
say:2:1041547902:1.source_cn: 莱卡，你想不想听我讲讲旅行中遇到的趣事？正好配上音乐！

say:3:1041547903:1.text: You just drank a ton of energy drinks. Are you sure you won't end up singing off-key?
say:3:1041547903:1.source_cn: 你刚刚喝了不少刺激性饮料，现在唱歌不会跑调吗？

say:4:1041547904:1.text: Remember when we were kids? One time you thought fermented dewbrew was sprint water and downed a whole cup in one go, and decided the roof was your personal concert stage.
say:4:1041547904:1.source_cn: 还记得小时候，有一次你错把发酵的露酿当成山泉饮，一口气...

say:6:1041547906:1.text: Wait, what? That happened?! How come I don't remember any of it?
say:6:1041547906:1.source_cn: 还、还有这种事？！我怎么一点都不记得？！

say:7:1041547907:1.text: Because you passed out halfway through your big solo.
say:7:1041547907:1.source_cn: 你只唱到一半就睡着了，当然没印象。

say:8:1041547908:1.text: Granny Dahnie had to use quickvines to catch you before you slid off the roof.
say:8:1041547908:1.source_cn: 要不是达赫妮婆婆及时发现，用速生藤托住了你，你肯定会顺...

say:9:1041547909:1.text: Master Arden even asked Granny who was singing that day, something about someone managing to miss seven out of eight notes.
say:9:1041547909:1.source_cn: 后来雅顿贤者来月湖村时，还问婆婆那天唱歌的人是谁，怎么...

say:10:1041547910:1.text: WHAT?! The old man heard it too?! My reputation is ruined...
say:10:1041547910:1.source_cn: 什么？！连老爷子也听到了……我的形象全毁了……！

say:11:1041547911:1.text: Relax! You were ten or so. I'm sure Master Arden wouldn't hold it against you.
say:11:1041547911:1.source_cn: 那时候你还小呢，雅顿贤者不会往心里去的。

say:12:1041547912:1.text: Now tell me about your travels! You can even sing the story if you want, for old time's sake.
say:12:1041547912:1.source_cn: 给我讲讲你最近的旅行故事吧，用唱歌的方式也可以。

say:13:1041547913:1.text: It's been so long since I've heard you sing, it's kind of nostalgic.
say:13:1041547913:1.source_cn: 好久没有听到你唱歌跑调了，也有点怀念呢。

say:14:1041547914:1.text: ... This time, I'm hitting every note perfectly!
